summary: Fixes from the independent review of the PDF-acquisition and OpenAlex-key work, and removal of the ignored mailto setting. Shared per-data-dir fetcher with per-host locks (the HTTP server rebuilds App per request, which had defeated pacing, Crawl-delay and robots caching); all fetch failures classified; every redirect hop must be https on a public host and passes robots and pacing; stricter public-host rules (alternate IPv4 spellings, trailing dots, single-label names); robots answers expire after 24 h and 429/5xx/3xx count as unavailable; append-only pdf_versions history (migration 006); Origin check on every POST and DELETE; migration 005 only ignores duplicate-column errors. The contact-email setting is removed because OpenAlex documents mailto as ignored (measured: identical limits with and without it).
scope_note: On top of aba281e. The owner's untracked .claude/settings.json and .claude/worktrees/ are excluded locally through .git/info/exclude at the owner's choice; nothing about them is committed.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call, no model operation or ceiling changed. Fewer outbound items: the user's email is no longer sent to OpenAlex. Extra requests: robots.txt is now re-read after 24 h and for redirect target hosts.
budget_impact.before: A per-request fetcher forgot pacing and robots; a real email went to OpenAlex as an ignored parameter.
budget_impact.after: Process-wide pacing and robots caching; no user email is sent.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app built; bundled backend and Tauri shell started in a throwaway HOME; window not clicked through

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; fixes and mailto removal

Two separate read-only code-review agents with fresh contexts (same model family as the author, not a human). Pass 1 found 8 issues in 1f5ada9..aba281e; pass 2 verified the fixes and found 5 residual items, which the author then fixed with tests; those last fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: The independent reviews were done by agents of the same model family; a human review has not been done. The final residual fixes (host guard, robots TTL, history order) were not re-read by a reviewer.
The Tauri window was started but not clicked through: macOS screen-recording and accessibility permissions were not available to the terminal.
A public-looking DNS name that resolves to a private address is not detected (no DNS resolution); NAT64-wrapped loopback is not covered.
attach_pdf uploads are single-use and the file moves before the database write.
